h: Shabbos Reveals the Divine Love Hidden Even Within Exile

p: (רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה לה, א)
the blessings go from aleph to tav,
the curses from vav to heh;
when a person refines his deeds;
it is only from vav to heh.
which is the middah of Malchus
there, as it were, He stands;
and as stated in the holy Zohar
who will be driven out with you.
'And for your transgressions your mother was sent away,' etc."
That is: even HaKadosh Baruch Hu
only the union is not revealed,
are HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
that there will be vav and heh,
but the union will not be revealed.
And this is what it says afterward,
as stated in the holy Zohar
for they attain a new additional soul
as at the time of Matan Torah,
And this is: even in the exiles,
and then the union is present;
as stated in the holy Zohar
and the union is at hand, etc."
And this is what it says,
like the market of the spice-merchants,
as stated in the holy Zohar.
and cursed them with eight, etc.:
until 'and their soul abhorred My statutes'" (Vayikra 26:15–43);
And this follows what they said
Aleph is at the start of the letters,
And this is because the Name Havayah
And this is what it says (Yeshayahu 54:7–8):
"For a brief moment I forsook you, etc.;
I hid My face from you for a moment,
but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you, etc."
That is, the forsaking and the anger
And the Gemara does not count
and it is not part of the rebuke;
And both are the words of the living God:
that it ends afterward with heh
that even in the brief moment of the present
"I hid My face from you for a moment"
that is, the union is in hiddenness;
as stated in the holy Zohar;
so that vav and heh are present,
but the union is in hiddenness.
for an additional soul is added,
which is the meal of Atika Kadisha,
as stated in the holy Zohar:
and the union is at hand."

paragraphs.text: Source: Megillah 29a — “תניא, רבי שמעון בן יוחי אומר: בוא וראה כמה חביבין ישראל לפני הקדוש ברוך הוא, שבכל מקום שגלו — שכינה עמהן. גלו למצרים — שכינה עמהן, שנאמר: ״הנגלה נגליתי לבית …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 57) — “§ It is taught in a baraita: Rabbi Shimon ben Yoḥai says: Come and see how beloved the Jewish people are before the Holy One, Blessed be He. As every place they were exiled, the Divine Presence went with them. …”
